About this trial

One schoolyard, one person: walk in, turn toward the reader, wave, then stop. Change age to inspect the same identity later in life.

This is a flat-stage trial. The 3D diorama remains in use. Turning corners, seated poses and furniture contact need separate tests.

The painted sample uses existing stand/run images on the same authored schoolyard floor. It is an art comparison, not a reproduction of the full painted renderer.
